description: New releases are held for 7 days so a compromised publish is caught before it lands here.
internalChecksFilter strict makes Renovate withhold the pull request until the age is met, rather than opening it and only reporting the age.
vulnerabilityAlerts overrides the wait to zero, so a security fix is never delayed.

To bypass the delay in an emergency, a human with write access merges the held pull request manually, or edits this file to lower minimumReleaseAge; both paths go through the CODEOWNERS review on renovate.json.
